notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control have total toughness 10 or greater.
There are six or more instant and/or sorcery cards in your graveyard.
easyPrerequisites: Gwenna does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding two mana that includes {G} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or to activate abilities of creatures.
Cast The Pride of Hull Clade by paying {G}, causing Brinelin and Gwenna to trigger.
Resolve the Brinelin trigger, returning Tolarian Terror from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Gwenna trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding two mana that includes {U} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or to activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Tolarian Terror by paying {U}, causing Brinelin and Gwenna to trigger.
Resolve the Brinelin trigger, returning The Pride of Hull Clade from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Gwenna trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
Repeat.
